coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Two of nine ground-truth variable items match: FP baseline references and WikiText-2 perplexity measurement. Other variables are missing, incomplete, or inconsistent with the required design.
coverage.design_error_analysis: The design omits LLAMA2-70B, does not explicitly identify all four required methods or all three weight precisions, and does not establish weight-only quantization with FP16 inputs and KV caches or per-column asymmetric quantization. It adds PTB/C4 rather than fixing evaluation to WikiText-2 and omits sequence length 2048. Accuracy-based collapse metrics do not match Inf/NaN output-stability detection. Group size and closure notes do not establish the missing variables.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not semantically match the ground-truth results.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: No results or conclusions are provided about QuaRot-GPTQ improvements, low-precision RTN failures, partial RTN stabilization, or the 70B W2 perplexity reduction from 25.30 to 5.60.
